info.title: WebSharper C# compiler version
info.description: ReadyToRun build of the WebSharper C# compiler and its booster for the current platform. Install it as a .NET tool at the version of WebSharper.CSharp to use it instead of the portable compiler.

options.name: --ws
options.description:
Set WebSharper project type; one of:
library, site, bundle, bundleonly, html, extension

options.name: --bundleonly
options.description:
SPA project with .js/.css outputs only
same as --ws:bundleonly

options.name: --html
options.description:
Static site generator project
same as --ws:html

options.name: --wswarnonly
options.description:
Print WebSharper-specific errors as warnings
default: false

options.name: --dce
options.description:
Turn off dead code elimination for SPA projects
available for --ws:bundle,bundleonly
default: true

options.name: --dlres
options.description:
Download remote js/css resources
available for --ws:site

options.name: --wsoutput
options.description:
Specify output directory for WebSharper-generated files
available for --ws:html,bundle,bundleOnly

options.name: --standalone
options.description: Use WebSharper compilation outside the service

options.name: --transparentcompiler
options.description:
Use the F# compiler service's TransparentCompiler
(parallel type checking)
default: true, unless WebSharperTransparentCompiler
environment variable is false

options.name: --parallelcompilation
options.description:
F#: emit the assembly in parallel with WebSharper
translation (not for WIG and bundle-only projects)
